entities.summary: The Tachibana clan (立花氏) was a Japanese clan of daimyō during Japan's Sengoku and Edo periods. Originally based in Tachibana castle in Kyūshū, the family's holdings were moved to the Yanagawa Domain in the far north-east of Honshū in the Edo period.
